description: This file defines a React component `PriceDataReload` which manages the UI for reloading and scheduling reloads of price data, including fetching reload status, manual reload, scheduling periodic reloads, and cancelling scheduled reloads. It interacts with backend networking functions and displays status and controls for the price data reload process.

classes.name: ReloadStatus
classes.description: Interface representing the reload scheduling status, including whether it is scheduled, interval hours, last run time, and next run time.

classes.name: PriceDataReloadProps
classes.description: Interface for the component's props, including access token, callback on success, button text, icon display toggle, size, type, and CSS class.

methods.name: fetchReloadStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current reload status from the backend and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleHardRefresh
methods.description: Performs an immediate reload of price data, displaying notifications based on success or failure.

methods.name: handleScheduleReload
methods.description: Schedules periodic reload of price data at the specified interval, with UI feedback.

methods.name: handleCancelReload
methods.description: Cancels the scheduled periodic reload, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Converts a datetime string to a localized string or 'Never' if null.

methods.name: getStatusText
methods.description: Returns a status text based on current reload schedule status.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Returns a color indicating the reload status.
